newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Devex sells magnesia unit to Indian group.
newsitem.headline: Devex sells magnesia unit to Indian group.

text.p: Junior miner Devex Ltd said on Monday it had agreed to sell its magnesia business Causmag Ore Co Pty Ltd to India-based Orind Industries for A$7 million.
The sale of the magnesia business, based in Young in central west New South Wales, would enable Devex to focus on expanding its gold operation at Gympie in Queensland, the company said.
Devex managing director Harry Adams said in a statement that the sale proceeds should double the company's cash reserves to about A$14 million.

Adams said he believed Orind, a leading international producer and exporter of magnesia refractories, would be able to expand the Australian magnesia business, which produces magnesite based products.
Operating control and the sale consideration would be transferred in stages to December 31, 1997, subject to regulatory approvals.
